lifecycle.register: Owner-visible approved work receives the next numeric checkpoint ID and is inserted in its category.
lifecycle.protect: PASS / PROTECTED requires explicit owner evidence and preserves the checkpoint against routine retesting.
lifecycle.reopen: A protected checkpoint can return to validation only with an explicit repository-backed reopening reason that preserves its prior PASS.
lifecycle.retire: Cancelled, merged, superseded or deprecated checkpoints remain in history with a reason and replacement link when applicable.
